# Baked-light end-to-end fixture (ADR-365)

A tiny project for `cargo xtask bake-check` and `crates/regia_cli/tests/bake_e2e.rs`. Tests copy it to a
temporary directory first; nothing is ever written here.

- `assets/levels/courtyard.level.ron` (scene v10): a sealed room (`Room`, inner walls ±2.5 m, outer ±2.8 m, so
  0.3 m thick, all static) at the origin; a 0.2-scale copy (`Marker`, static) 24 m east; a 0.2-scale copy
  (`Rover`, `GiMobility::Dynamic`) that the export skips. Earth atmosphere at noon (day 172, 40° N). No ground: an
  open cell sees the sky in every direction. The level names no volume; `--write-level` adds it.
- `assets/meshes/room.gltf`: the room as one primitive, outer box facing out and inner box facing in (geometric
  normals from the winding agree with the `NORMAL` attribute), base color 0.5, metallic 0, roughness 1. The buffer
  is an embedded `data:` URI. It was generated by a short script that checks every triangle's winding against its
  face normal.

What the checks expect after `regia bake-gi --from-scene … --bake --cpu --write-level`:

- An open cell (14.8, 0, 0), normal up: the sky component's irradiance / π equals the exported uniform `sky`
  radiance within 6 % (the two rooms hide about 2 % of the sky there), coverage 1.
- The room's centre (0, 0, 0): every component exactly 0 (no light enters a sealed room), coverage 1.
